verification_notes: Forty-five distinct journal ISSNs were surveyed through the Crossref publication-date endpoint. Membership of the expanded trial was fixed before the rankings ran. The publisher-contents checks cover these particular windows and titles.

For the ten added Crossref journals, the date is the published day, an abstract is required, and the DOI must carry CC BY on the version of record effective by the corresponding week end. This criterion matched 358 collected DOIs over four weeks and 76 in the held-out week.

Across the four Cogitatio journals, Crossref supplied 45 publication-date records but labelled the version on each license unspecified. The publisher OAI records give the published version and CC BY on the exact DOI. Records returned by its ART set must also carry that set in their own header.

The HTML comparison read 51 issue tables of contents from the 2026 and in-progress 2027 issue inventories and checked each matching article page. Some issue citation metadata only recorded 2027. The article page gave the actual 2026 publication day in its Published field. All 54 eligible articles agreed across publisher article page, issue list, OAI and stored item.

One extra unfiltered OAI record, 10.17645/pag.13626, was labelled editorial and was absent from the issue list. It contributed no evidence. For Geographica Helvetica the volume comparison verified identifiers and dates and did not independently enumerate article types.

Eight other journals contributed 37 deterministic publisher checks. All dates and stored identifiers matched. An explicit genre was recorded for 24. For the remaining records, publication-date verification alone makes no claim about genre.

The nine Education Policy Analysis Archives records in the survey carried CC BY-SA rather than the CC BY version-of-record metadata accepted by this pilot. Their absence marks a gap in this intake, not an assessment of scholarly merit.

relevance_case_review.judgement: Missed original theory. The authors derive a triadic teaching model and state testable propositions.
Missed original theory. The argument extends a mechanism from organizations to differentiated social systems and specifies conditions.
Missed theoretical model. It specifies a two-stage mechanism and empirical tests while explicitly withholding claims of validation.
A publisher-labelled Original Research article proposes a model of teacher preparation following thematic analysis of prior work. It merits consideration as a model, not as observed learner outcomes.
This publisher-labelled Perspective reports an individual counselling case and group mentoring sessions in Budapest. Its authors and participants differ from the UK studies recovered over 28 days.
The publisher labels this Review. A comparative analysis of safeguards and access routes under Italian law gives an original doctrinal contribution.
A Viewpoint argues for a normative relationship between criminal justice and planetary health. Attribute it as a legal and philosophical argument.

cases.reason: A lesson-planning comparison, a qualitative study of trainees reasoning with AI and a proposed framework for teachers address different professional tasks. The synthesis distinguishes the sources of evidence.

All three examine the counterfactual comparison in panel causal inference. Only the first specifically distinguishes interventions under staggered adoption. The others address noise and spillovers in more general panel designs.

Each survey measures intention to adopt an educational technology. The 350-student Ghanaian study explicitly reports convenience sampling. The other two report purposive selection. The metaverse model also draws on several technology-acceptance traditions.

Only the international questionnaire directly compares reported monitoring and reliance on AI. A Ghanaian survey models cognition and self-regulation. The scale-validation study measures feedback engagement and integrity intentions.

Each study compares measured student achievement after technology-supported and conventional instruction. The summary identifies the outcome and comparison for each setting, including the null speaking-proficiency result despite positive self-reports.

Budapest and Hamburg identify actors in suburban planning. The inventory of 69 German projects describes development patterns and does not identify who decided. All three are in the same issue. Overlap between the German samples was not established.

All three test what assessment scores can represent. A dominant common dimension appears in the Colombian and Kazakhstani studies. The Honduran instrument supports separate, correlated grammar and vocabulary factors.

All three preprints study the design or evaluation of treatment-assignment rules. The synthesis separates adaptive design, risk of treating someone who would be harmed and sampling risk, with the mathematical guarantees tied to their assumptions.
Counsellor empowerment, college career agency, teacher wellbeing, theatre teaching goals and hotel employment conditions do not give three comparable observations of one professional outcome.

Moroccan experts assessed a framework. Chinese colleges reported policy translation into routines. The Saudi and Kazakhstani analyses related institutional capability to sustainability and retention intentions. The four do not measure a common outcome or document the same institutional process in three settings.
School science aspirations, job alignment for university graduates and attitudes toward inclusive physical education answer different questions.

These three qualitative studies can answer how personal contact mediates isolation and power in platform work. Madrid care workers used collectives, Hamburg riders formed fragile ties in shared spaces, and Viennese cleaners negotiated trust and control with clients. Preserve each setting and relationship.
Football supporters and ownership, a postcolonial research agenda and contestation over a former military site address distinct processes and constituencies.
Practicum preparation, medical school climate, MOOC engagement and pandemic social support are different outcomes measured in different settings.
Guided GenAI prompts, teachers designing mathematics lessons and student practice of German grammar concern distinct learning or teaching outcomes.

A local-projection command, inference after latent-type estimation, common-shock precision and an application of partially linear models target different statistical quantities. Panel data alone does not supply a shared estimand.
Student accounts in a cross-campus course, a mapping of GenAI pedagogy literature and administrators describing their work give no shared outcome across the three.

Two classroom studies concern children’s social-emotional competence. The other studies concern school climate and wellbeing, and time perspective across adulthood. The comparable pair falls below the three-paper minimum.

longer_window_cases.reason: Two Chinese postgraduate students at a UK university, interviews with 15 Pakistani students in London and a separate Budapest mentoring study describe how international students handle unfamiliar academic or social expectations. The three teams differ. Two studies were newly grouped in the longer window. These accounts cannot establish the effectiveness of mentoring.

Two studies analyse demographic threat arguments from voters and political parties. The third examines how state institutions implement Indigenous rights in Nuevo León. It supplies no third study of threat narratives. All three newly appeared in a candidate over 28 days.

A nine-paper group mixes European platform labour, urban food governance, football ownership and other topics. The qualitative platform-work trio seen in the weekly exclusions survives inside this larger group. The whole candidate does not support one common finding.

editorial_review.target: Nine passes in each prespecified sample of ten. For ranked cases both comparable grouping and accurate claims are required. These judgements use the original edition copy before reader notes. No second independent reviewer was used.
editorial_review.selection: Five weeks, including the separate September holdout. Split each edition at the midpoint, assigning the middle rank to the high half. Cycle through dates from opposite ends of the disjoint halves. For exclusions, sort fully rejected, successfully reviewed candidates within date by SHA-256 of the sorted stable paper IDs joined by a newline, then cycle twice through dates. All eight ranks had three evidence papers.

november_5_followup.reason: The studies address reliability and use of self-report instruments. The US feasibility study reports internal consistency and exploratory associations. The three student studies also tested measurement structure. A reader note distinguishes these.

Three theoretical or conceptual syntheses propose ways to integrate technology into professional curricula. The reading distinguishes a programme-level design process, a model for health professions simulation and a Malaysian BIM framework. Each awaits empirical validation.

Two Ghanaian surveys address intention to use educational technology. Trust and reported civic AI use in the three Arab countries concern a different outcome. The synthesis scopes the findings and a reader note makes the distinction explicit.

review.assessment: The cohort study measured self-assessed practicum documentation. The systematic review evaluated intercultural teacher preparation. The bibliometric analysis mapped digital-literacy publications. The synthesis identifies the unit of analysis correctly, but teacher preparation alone supplies no shared outcome. A dated reader note identifies which study observed each measure.

stability.editorial_judgement: Funding-agency policies, the legal status of maritime personnel and Chinese privacy obligations address different decisions. The synthesis characterises each case accurately. A common implementation gap provides a broad theme, with no single duty or comparable outcome across all three.
stability.interpretation: Different parent caches carried earlier classifications, vectors and editorial decisions into the two complete runs. This is a measured reproducibility limit. These observations do not isolate the effect of any single component.
